docs.abstract: Over 21 months, the pop superstar’s culture-dominating stage show doubled the gross of its closest competitor, according to ticket sales figures confirmed for the first time.

headline.main: Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour Grand Total: A Record $2 Billion
headline.print_headline: A Cash Rocket Hurtles Beyond All the Stars

multimedia.caption: Taylor Swift onstage at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey in May 2023. Her tour wrapped in Vancouver on Sunday night after 149 performances.
multimedia.credit: Jutharat Pinyodoonyachet for The New York Times
